answer: In this PoA design, each bonded identity risks slashing for equivocation, and evidence tying k identities to coordinated equivocation incurs a penalty proportional to k² rather than k. A wharf of aliases offers no shelter: when a sybil swarm is detected, an additional exponential multiplier in capital loss makes coordination increasingly costly. Asymmetric depreciation further impedes recovery; karst-like fragmentation and willow-like branching do not hide verifiable links between signed votes.
